Experience the warmth of our local haven, where every visit feels like a homecoming. Come, stay awhile, and taste the difference for yourself! ☕️

featured_reviews.name: kunal mohite
featured_reviews.review_text:
During my recent visit, I found Little Bites Café to be incredibly welcoming. The entire staff treated every guest with the utmost professionalism and a genuinely caring attitude.

We ordered French fries, a paneer burger, and a chicken burger — all of which were freshly prepared, lightly crisped (not overly oily), and most importantly, absolutely finger-licking delicious!

As we were leaving, one of the staff members surprised us with a warm, thoughtful gesture that truly made the experience unforgettable. That small act of kindness has me hooked on this café.

This is a hidden gem in Naigaon — a place no local should miss!

A big thank you to the entire team for your warm hospitality. See you again very soon!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Kunal,

We're delighted to hear that you had an exceptional experience at Little Bites Café! We're thrilled to know that our staff made you feel welcome and that our food exceeded your expectations. It's wonderful to hear that you enjoyed the freshness, crispiness, and flavors of our French fries, paneer burger, and chicken burger.

We're particularly grateful for your kind words about our staff's professionalism, caring attitude, and thoughtful gestures. It's moments like these that make all our hard work worthwhile, and we're grateful to have customers like you who appreciate the little things that make a big difference.

Thank you for recommending Little Bites Café to your fellow locals. We're proud to be a part of the Naigaon community and strive to provide a unique experience that sets us apart.

Once again, thank you for your wonderful review and for choosing Little Bites Café. We can't wait to welcome you back soon and serve you another delicious meal.

Warm Regards,
Team Little Bites

Warm Regards,
Team Little Bites

featured_reviews.review_text:
Dhabba on the access road towards Naigaon east west bridge... convenient location.. and u have the cashier welcoming u from the entrance ...
We had a soup and a starter ..  and the request for non-spicy soup was really non-spicy... so well done..  unlike some other pricey food joints who do not listen to customers and serve what they wish..
The malai tandoori chicken tikka was nice..  Like a non-veg dahi vadaa.. huge chicken tikka.. so good helping..
The ambience is road facing .. so u k ow what to expect .. its a Dhabba..
The waiters were running around to serve ... and it was quite quick..
Keep your mind open for a quick bite andnu won't be disheartened..
Wishing the team the very best for the day's to come.

featured_reviews.review_text: One of best place to buy Biryani in entire Vasai. I tried from different places but the taste that we get here is the best. Must try.. 70 rupees half. 90 rupees full.  Order price 700 rupees for 1kg rice, 1 kg chicken.

featured_reviews.name: Rocky Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text: Good quality Chicken Biryani and Chicken Curry, however nowadays the quality of the Chicken Curry has been deteriorating. Nowadays they dilute it with water and give the reason, that nobody likes it thick, which is a lie, bcoz I bought Chicken Curry from them for at least 7 Years and almost on a daily basis

featured_reviews.name: Kunal Chiplunkar
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best place to have biryani in the neighborhood of naigaon. I have been having Biryani here for past 6-7 years now. I started having Biryani here for 40  rupees and now it's for 80 rupees for Chicken biryani. Mr. Meraj Bhai was a chef in Delhi darbar, we get that awesome quality biryani. Apart from biryani you can even enjoy kheema pav made of lamb meat, chicken keba, chicken tikka , Russian kebab, chicken cutlet , they also accept party order. It is a restaurant run by a Muslim person and People from all caste and creed come here to have biryani, I love this part of secularism. Note: all chicken products is halal and it's a "No beef" restaurant.
